title: When the Letters Sings
author: Jonah Yarrow
blurb: Dominic Okafor, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
